annotations.title: List the cards due for an agent run

description: Lists the cards scheduled for an agent run that are due: kanban cards — or tree tasks (an open checkbox, no column) — given to agent:claude, with an "Agent run: YYYY-MM-DD" attribute on or before `today`, that the user answers for, that are ready for an agent (deliverable, done criteria, context, gate), not done (a ticked task is done), not waiting in a review column, not already run for that date and with no delivery waiting for review. Oldest date first, 3 at most per run; the rest is counted. Also lists the scheduled cards that will NOT run, with the reason. Use it when the user (or a scheduled task) asks to run the due agent cards: then, for each due card, call card_prompt, do the work, and call deliver_card — never more than 3. Read-only.

today.description: The user's local date, YYYY-MM-DD (the server's clock may be on another day). Left out, the server's date.
